prompt: RimWorld animal sprite: an alien riverbank ambusher the size of a cow, built from three unequal rigid blunt body lobes that meet around an off-centre torso, a wide biting mouth set low in one side with acid-green ridged gums and chalky peg teeth, small deep-set eyes in the joint between two lobes; it stands on the planted tips of its lobes; bruise-blue and petrol-violet hide with an oily sheen, lavender joint folds, grey-ochre river silt caked on its back and cracking off along the joints.
